verdict.rationale: Grok Bot documents sending a photo into a chat via the iPhone share sheet (docs-21). A community report describes a bot generating a pattern from the user's logo, which weakly implies it can work from image inputs (comm-5). No documentation or hands-on evidence shows the assistant accurately interpreting screenshot or photo content. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim of image/screenshot understanding, desktop screenshot upload, evidence of interpretation accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration.
